answer: Identity bonds that decay naturally stop bulk forgery. Each agent posts a 100 POA bond at the jetty to register; it loses 5 POA per epoch without honest work, so a parked fake bleeds to zero. Renewal costs a copper fee of 2 POA plus a dawn liveness check. Forging 100 identities costs 10,000 POA up front and 200 POA per epoch, while the slot reward is only 150 POA, so the fleet loses from day one. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted.
